name: the guard is never installed (the state before the fix)
why: Without _ehKeyGuardInstall() Event Horizon's bubble-phase listener runs h, e, r, … on MusicBrainz's page: the initial page and a rendered table are left (org/majkinetor.org, measured 2026-11-06/08).

name: Shift is not ignored (the key is compared unlowercased)
why: Event Horizon reads Shift+H as h (keyCombo() lowercases one character and adds no shift+), so a guard comparing e.key itself lets Shift+H through to the editing history.

name: V is blocked too
why: V is Event Horizon's on/off switch, the user's way from MusicBrainz's page to EH's view and back; taking it would lock the user out of Event Horizon on every page this script runs on.

name: keys are blocked inside Event Horizon's own view
why: While EH shows (<html data-mbu-dock>) its keys are its own business; the guard must yield there.

name: keys typed into a field are blocked
why: preventDefault() on a keydown inside an input cancels the character: the filter fields could no longer take h, e, r, o, s.

name: keys are blocked on pages without Event Horizon
why: With neither #eh-launch nor <html data-mbu-st> nobody binds these keys for Event Horizon; another script's single keys that honour defaultPrevented would be silenced for nothing.
grep: no Event Horizon on the page

name: the setting is ignored
why: sa_block_eh_single_keys off must give Event Horizon's keys back to a user who wants them on MusicBrainz's pages.

name: the navigation guard asks for clicks in Event Horizon's view again
why: Without the _saBody() check Guard 1 sees EH's in-place link clicks (its H key clicks one too) and asks 'You are about to leave this page' for a navigation that leaves nothing (vzell, 2026-11-08).

edits.find:
if (!_saBody().contains(e.target)) return;
            // A click another handler already took
edits.replace: // A click another handler already took

name: Guard 4 never warns (no beforeunload prompt from EH's view)
why: H in EH's view loads a new page (probe case E) and V after EH navigated reloads (EH:11490): the rendered table is lost without a word.

name: Guard 4 also prompts on MusicBrainz's own page
why: After OK on SAED's own question the browser would ask a second time.

name: Guard 4's isLoaded check removed (covered by construction)
why: Recorded as a known overlap, not a gap: initNavigationGuard() is installed only by the two render tails (fetch, disk load), so before a render no beforeunload listener exists at all and the isLoaded check cannot be seen. The 'no table rendered' test (with a mouse click first, so Chromium could show a prompt) pins the behaviour either way.
